primary_source_support: Primary source identifies the mature peptide as the 26-residue Dermaseptin-PP with C-terminal amidation.
DRAMP sequence matches the unmodified 26-residue core but its raw metadata says C-terminal modification is Free.

record_audits.conflict_context: DRAMP activity, IC50, and hemolysis text is supported by the primary article, but DRAMP raw metadata marks C-terminal modification as Free while the paper verifies Dermaseptin-PP-NH2. The conflict is preserved rather than normalized away.
record_audits.review_notes: Use DRAMP activity rows as secondary provenance for source-supported IC50/HC50 values, but do not mark the full DRAMP identity record source_verified because terminal modification conflicts with primary source.
